pendingSuggestions.title: Easy Mediterranean Chicken and Rice Skillet
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breasts, diced into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the diced chicken for 5 minutes.
Stir in the white rice, chicken broth, dried oregano, and black olives.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and let cool slightly before serving.

pendingSuggestions.title: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
On a large baking sheet, toss shrimp, bell pepper, and onion with olive oil and taco seasoning.
Spread the ingredients in a single even layer.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Serve inside warmed tortillas.

pendingSuggestions.title: Slow Cooker Shredded Mexican Chicken
instructions: Place chicken breasts in the bottom of the slow cooker.
Sprinkle taco seasoning over the chicken.
Pour the salsa and lime juice on top.
Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours.
Shred the chicken with two forks and stir back into the juices.
pendingSuggestions.notes: Perfect for Sunday meal prep to eat on Monday.

pendingSuggestions.title: Simple Mediterranean Garlic Butter Shrimp
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side until they turn pink and opaque.
Stir in the lemon juice and remove from heat.
Top with crumbled feta cheese and serve warm.
pendingSuggestions.notes: Serve over rice or with soft pita bread.

pendingSuggestions.title: Easy 15-Minute Fish Tacos
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillets (like cod or tilapia)
instructions: Rub fish fillets with olive oil and sprinkle with mild taco seasoning on both sides.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook fish for 3-4 minutes per side, until it easily flakes with a fork.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 15 seconds.
Flake the fish into bite-sized pieces and divide among tortillas.
Top with shredded lettuce and a dollop of sour cream.
pendingSuggestions.notes: Flaked fish is soft and easy for a toddler to eat.

pendingSuggestions.title: Cozy Greek Lemon Chicken Soup
instructions: In a large pot, bring chicken broth and diced carrots to a boil. Add chicken breasts and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through. Remove chicken, shred, and set aside.
Stir the white rice into the boiling broth, cover, and cook on low for 15 minutes.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs and lemon juice. Slowly ladle 1 cup of hot broth into the egg mixture while whisking constantly to temper the eggs.
Pour the egg mixture and shredded chicken back into the pot, stirring well.
Simmer on low for an additional 2-3 minutes until thickened. Do not boil. Let cool slightly before serving.
pendingSuggestions.notes: Makes a generous 6 servings. Thick, creamy, and holds up beautifully as leftovers for Monday.

pendingSuggestions.title: Kid-Friendly Baked Turkey Burgers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a baking sheet with foil.
In a bowl, mix ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic powder, and salt until just combined.
Shape into 3 flat patties and place on the baking sheet.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Serve on buns, cutting your toddler's portion into small bite-sized pieces.
pendingSuggestions.notes: Baking keeps these burgers incredibly moist and easy to chew for toddlers.
